claims: Structure includes creation, access, write, and change timestamps plus attributes
FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES is required to set members
Zero timestamp means preserve current value
Minus one suppresses access/write/change updates for operations on the same handle; minus two reenables updates on NTFS/ReFS

candidate_protocol: Record actual target basic4 and attributes; never substitute source metadata
Reject sentinel timestamps that cannot be restored literally by documented API
Apply ObjectID extension only to an identity-checked scratch file
Restore recorded basic information with FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES
Verify reopened full IDs, full64 ObjectID, security, attributes, all4timestamps, hardlinks and unrelated files
Supported shutdown; independently inspect raw NTFS metadata and repeat normal reboot
